paragraphs: This image hits hard. 🥀 The most dangerous lies are the ones we tell ourselves. When we hide from the truth, we create a fertile ground for sin to take root and grow in the shadows, choking out our peace.
Don't let your heart become a prison of secrets. The only remedy is the piercing light of honesty. 🕯️ It’s time to break the chains.
🔥 "And you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free." – John 8:32
